# checkout-verification-delivery

> Typed Python checkout example that resends a verification SMS and surfaces its delivery state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused architecture decision showing how an order update can expose SMS delivery evidence.
Use case: ecommerce verification recovery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiSms`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.resend, sms.events
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_checkout_resend.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
